title: API Documentation
descriptionPart1: Official API reference and OIDC discovery documentation for

oidc.name: OIDC Discovery
oidc.description: Returns the OpenID Connect discovery document containing issuer, endpoints, and supported scopes/claims.
oidc.response: JSON object with OpenID Provider metadata.

auth.name: Authorization Endpoint
auth.description: Initiates the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with user consent and PKCE validation.

params.redirect_uri: Where to redirect the user after auth.
params.state: Opaque value for maintaining state to mitigate CSRF.
params.code_challenge: PKCE code challenge generated from SHA-256.

auth.response: Redirects to the redirect_uri with a `code` and `state`.

token.name: Token Endpoint
token.description: Exchanges an authorization code, refresh token, or client credentials for access tokens.

params.code: The authorization code (required for authorization_code flow).
params.redirect_uri: Must match the original redirect URI (for authorization_code).
params.client_secret: Your application's Client Secret (for confidential clients or client_credentials).
params.code_verifier: PKCE code verifier (required if PKCE was used during authorization).
params.refresh_token: The refresh token to rotate (for refresh_token grant).

token.response: JSON object containing access_token, id_token, and refresh_token.

userinfo.name: UserInfo Endpoint
userinfo.description: Retrieves claims about the authenticated end-user based on granted scopes.

params.authorization: Bearer token containing the access token.

userinfo.response: JSON object containing user claims (sub, name, email, avatar, etc.).

jwks.name: JWKS Endpoint
jwks.description: Returns the JSON Web Key Set (RS256 public keys) used to sign and verify ID tokens.
jwks.response: JSON Web Key Set containing active public keys.

revoke.name: Token Revocation Endpoint
revoke.description: Revokes an active access or refresh token according to RFC 7009.

params.token: The token you want to revoke.

user_session.name: Inter-Service User Session Bridge
user_session.description: Verifies active user session from cross-subdomain cookies (*.clouburstlab.com) and returns scoped profile data.

params.cookie: User session cookie ('session_token') automatically forwarded with credentials: 'include'.
params.user_id: Optional user ID for machine-to-machine server calls without cookies.

user_session.response: JSON object with { authenticated: true, user: { ...filteredFields }, scopes }.

connected_drives.name: Connected Cloud Drives & Credentials
connected_drives.description: Returns decrypted OAuth credentials for the user's connected drives (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox).

params.refresh: Optional boolean ('true') to proactively refresh expired access tokens.

connected_drives.response: JSON object with decrypted access_token, refresh_token, and expiration TTL.

bridge_docs.name: AI & Agent Machine Docs
bridge_docs.description: Returns comprehensive, AI-friendly API documentation in pure Markdown format for automated agents.
